article.story: MORAGA, Calif. -- — Darius Bivins scored 20 points off the bench to help lead Saint Mary’s past UIC 84-61 on Friday night. Bivins added five rebounds for the Gaels (3-1). Mantas Juzenas contributed 14 points and 10 rebounds, while Evangelos Zougris scored 12. Benny Gealer led the way for the Flames (3-1) with 18 points. Jayce Nathaniel added 11 points. Saint Mary’s took the lead for good with 8:55 left in the first half. The score was 42-24 at halftime, with Bivins racking up 16 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
